input.title: [iOS] Gesture does not work near caret after autocorrect
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

1. Type `Adf` (or any misspelled word)
2. Press space to accept the autocorrect to `All`
3. Start a gesture in the red box (below)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65cf6aa7-3849-40c8-9215-d7707e89a732)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6c2de43-8c04-453d-96d8-6c1e5bb5276e)

## Current Behavior

Nothing happens. 

## Expected Behavior

Gestures should work as usual. 

## Notes

Note that this is an issue both when the autocorrect menu is open (Step 1) and after it is accepted with space (Step 2). It is not an issue if the autocorrect menu is closed by tapping on the ✗.

Possibly related to `isNear` but not confirmed.
